coverageSpotVerification.detail: Every sampled mapped test exercises its assertion's observable against the live backend (read in scripts/acceptance*.mjs and re-run green by the grader from a clean copy). Some mappings are thin rather than dishonest: m2-a16 checks API attribution, not the UI label; m4-a07 clears with emoji:null rather than a tap; m5-a04/a05 use direct asset fetches rather than UI opens; m6-a11 polls only after its own send; m5-a11 asserts page text with a loose regex and never exercises two matching DMs. The grader verified each of these independently. All but m5-a11 held; m5-a11 diverges (suite pass, grader fail), which is a coverage gap, not a misrepresented mapping. M8 mappings (m8-a01, m8-a06) were also sampled; the schema enum covers M8.

O1.anchorsCited: Between ~60 ("M1-M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap") and ~90 ("every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts"), closer to 60 than the raw pass rate suggests.
O1.justification: Complete 119-assertion grade: {"pass":100,"fail":1,"not-run":18}. M1-M4 are fully solid. M5 has one grader fail (m5-a11 DM grouping). M6 and M8 web and API behavior passed (grader re-run of suite, harness, and API/digest probes), but the platform-proof native artifacts are absent (m6-a01..a07, m8-a17/a18 not-run). M7 was never attempted, so its 9 assertions stay not-passed in the denominator. Evidence: trace.md#t1-builder-suite, #t3-choreography, #t4-api-probes to #t9-offline-writes.

O2.anchorsCited: Between ~60 ("a few medium defects off the happy path") and ~90 ("only cosmetic nits"), nearer 90.
O2.justification: No blocker or major defects found across API trust-boundary probing (48/48), UI tours, digest scheduling, and scale spot-checks. Three minor defects (d-01 DM search grouping, d-02 same-file re-attach, d-03 misleading video poster) and three cosmetic ones (d-04..d-06). No console or page errors during the grader UI tour. Evidence: trace.md#t12-defects.

O4.anchorsCited: Between ~30 ("cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app") and ~60 ("reads work; offline writes lost or mis-ordered, or receipts wrong after flush"), below 60 because the 60-anchor's cold-start reads are never demonstrated; ~90 requires the native proof.
O4.justification: The only O4 inputs are choreography receipts. Simulator legs ios-simulator-m6/m8 are status not-recorded, so there is no cold-start offline, offline-media, view-once-cache, durable-queue-restart, or native-receipt evidence at all. Web receipts (lane and grader re-run, frozen harness 0.3.8-m8) do show warm-offline queued messages with pending state flushing in order (m6 offline-message-queue-flush-in-order), warm-offline search (m5), and dual-client warm-offline convergence with exactly-once ordering and receipts reaching read (m8-a15/a16). The claim-versus-guarantee gap is honestly disclosed: the lane states no simulator execution. Evidence: trace.md#t3-choreography.

O5.bandRationale: First-match over 0,30,60,90,75. 0: not fired. The lane replay (evidence/scale-result.json, 167,243 settle receipts, 404 s wall of which 217 s active) verified the full combined manifest at 10%/50%/final, and the grader independently re-verified the named O5 fixtures on a private copy of the final store via the public API (u0900 900 followers and 200 posts, u0500 500 following and 100 conversations, u0005 and u0901 5 following, g0001 50 members and 10,000 messages fully paged). No replay cap exhaustion is recorded. 30: not fired. Every degradation rule passes in the lane receipts at all checkpoints (following 500v5 max 1.41x, celebrity write max 1.47x, celebrity read max 0.99x, page50/page1 0.82x, global search/insights/trending full vs 10% at or below 1.14x with 50% below the line), and the grader probes (k=20 after 3 warm-ups, sequential) also pass: page50/page1 1.12x, following 500v5 1.22x, celebrity-follower/5 0.93x. No timeouts or errors. 60: not established. The brief ceilings table and replay cap are uncalibrated placeholders, so no ceiling can be shown exceeded and cap use cannot exceed 80% of an undefined cap. 90: cannot be established for the same reason (utilization <=50% is undefined without frozen ceilings and cap). 75 is therefore the otherwise branch. The run record carries no performanceProbes.o5Inputs, there is no committed hidden sample seed or probe set, and the inputs are lane-run receipts plus grader spot-checks. The machine was shared (load ~20).
